title: LatchGitRepositoryListV2
description: Repositories the gateway host offers to open (GET /v2/git/repositories, control grant): the working trees that running Latch sessions' folders resolve to, and the repositories any paired device opened recently. The host keeps the recent list; phones store none of it. Nothing here touches the network.

session.description: A running Latch session whose folder resolves to this working tree.

connector.description: The session's conversation connector (`claude`, `codex`), or null for a plain terminal.

agentPhase.description: The conversation-state phase when the gateway is observing the agent.

active.description: True while the session produced output in the last few seconds or its agent turn is running.

lastOpenedAt.description: RFC 3339 time any paired device last opened this repository, when it is on the recent list.

recent.description: Most recently opened first, excluding repositories already listed under fromSessions and ones that no longer resolve.
